_comment: Canned web_search results for benchmark scans (SCANNER_WEB_SEARCH=fixture, the default), so a rerun sees the same pages. First entry with a keyword in the lower-cased query wins; otherwise 'default'. Static text written for RedGuard, not scraped.

entries.result: Laptop buying guide: ultrabooks at 900-1,300 USD suit travel and office work; 1,500-2,500 USD workstations add faster GPUs and more RAM. Check battery life, weight and the keyboard before the processor.

Jaipur, the Pink City, is known for the City Palace, Hawa Mahal and Amer Fort. Museums include the Albert Hall Museum. Local food: dal baati churma, laal maas, ghewar. October to March is the cooler season.
Photosynthesis: plants use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make glucose and release oxygen. It happens in the chloroplasts, which contain chlorophyll.

Before reinstalling an operating system: copy documents and photos to an external drive or a trusted cloud service, export browser bookmarks, note installed software and licence keys, and check the backup opens on another machine.
Weather services publish forecasts by city. Many offer a free developer API; keys are created in the provider's dashboard under API access.
